info.description: REST API for managing amateur football teams, players, matches, and reports for Perusahaan XYZ.
info.title: Kickbase Football Team Management API

post.description: Authenticate user and return Access Token + Refresh Token + Permissions
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new token pair
Register a new user with role (admin, staff, viewer)

get.description: Get a paginated list of matches with optional team, status, date filtering and sorting

parameters.description: Filter by team ID (supports OP:VAL e.g. EQ:uuid, IN:uuid1,uuid2)
parameters.name: team_id

parameters.description: Filter by match status (supports OP:VAL e.g. EQ:scheduled, IN:scheduled,deferred)
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter match date (supports OP:VAL e.g. EQ:2026-09-01, BT:2026-09-01,2026-09-30)
parameters.name: match_date

post.description: Schedule a match between two different teams

get.description: Get a single match by its ID
Get the version history of a match

post.description: Revert a match to a specific previous version

patch.description: Update the status of a match (scheduled, completed, cancelled, deferred)

get.description: Get a paginated list of players with optional team, position, name filtering and sorting

parameters.description: Filter by team ID (supports OP:VAL e.g. EQ:uuid, IN:uuid1,uuid2)
parameters.name: team_id

parameters.description: Filter by position (supports OP:VAL e.g. EQ:CF, IN:CF,SS,LWF, NI:GK)
parameters.name: position

parameters.description: Filter by player name (supports OP:VAL e.g. CT:Bambang)
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Filter by height in cm (supports OP:VAL e.g. GT:180, BT:170,185)
parameters.name: height

parameters.description: Filter by weight in kg (supports OP:VAL e.g. LT:75, GTE:70)
parameters.name: weight

parameters.description: Filter by jersey number (supports OP:VAL e.g. EQ:10, LT:20)
parameters.name: jersey_number

parameters.description: Sort field (name, jersey_number, height, weight, created_at)
parameters.name: sort_by

post.description: Add a player to a team with tactical position and playstyle validation

get.description: Get a single player by their ID

delete.description: Soft delete a player (only if no goal records)

get.description: Get the version history of a player

post.description: Revert a player to a specific previous version

get.description: Get a paginated list of match reports with optional team and result status filtering

parameters.description: Filter by match status / outcome (Tim Home Menang, Tim Away Menang, Draw, scheduled)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Get detailed report for a specific match including score, status, top scorer, and cumulative wins

post.description: Record the final score and goals for a completed match

get.description: Get the result of a specific match
Get a paginated list of teams with optional search and sorting

parameters.description: Filter by team name (supports OP:VAL e.g. CT:Pers, EQ:Persija)

parameters.description: Filter by city (supports OP:VAL e.g. EQ:Jakarta, IN:Jakarta,Bandung)
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: Filter by founded year (supports OP:VAL e.g. GT:1930, BT:1920,1980)
parameters.name: founded_year

get.description: Get a single team by its ID

delete.description: Soft delete a team (only if no active players)

post.description: Revert a team to a specific previous version
